newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Vietnam gets loan for largest cement plant. [CORRECTED 11:44 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Vietnam gets loan for largest cement plant. [CORRECTED 11:44 GMT]

text.p: The Asian Development Bank said on Friday (corrects day) it has approved a $30 million loan to partly fund construction of the largest cement plant in Vietnam.
The Manila-based regional bank said in a statement it was also arranging an additional $26.5 million for Nghi Son Cement Corp Ltd (NSCC) but did not give details.
NSCC is a joint venture between Nihon-Mitsubishi Cement Corp and Vietnam National Cement Corp, a state owned enterprise.
The firm plans to set up a cement plant with an annual output of 2.14 million tonnes and construct a port at Nghi Son, 210 km (130 miles) south of Hanoi.
Total project cost is pegged at $373 million. The International Finance Corp, the investment arm of the World Bank, and the Export Import Bank of Japan will co-finance the project, the ADB said.
